items.title: FETTUCCINE: Fast and efficient brain-to-text decoding on mobile devices
items.description: Recent advances in speech neuroprostheses have enabled new communication avenues for people who have lost the ability to speak due to neurological illness or injury. These systems can decode neural activity during attempted speech into text by relying on language priors to achieve high decoding accuracy.
